speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a history of gait and limb ataxia; could you tell me when these symptoms first started and if they have progressed over time? Additionally, do you experience any other neurological symptoms like weakness, numbness, or vision changes?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Sclerosis

Given the recent onset of ataxia and clumsiness affecting the right side, could you describe your full medical history, including any past episodes of vision loss, numbness, or weakness, and whether these symptoms worsened with heat or exertion?
